a.lede: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.
a.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11

b.title: Microsoft’s new Surface Laptop Ultra finally has a starting price (you should sit down)
